known_limitations: Implements a CLI-only subset of the reviewed requirements; no graphical workflow, preview editor, or thumbnail composition UI is provided.
Workspace/project persistence is minimal and does not restore all advanced editing state, relinking workflows, or split/merge composition details.
Interleaving, page duplication, rotation preview, and complex mismatch handling are not fully implemented.
No command-line option set is provided beyond the implemented merge, split, preview, and basic workspace commands.
The tool does not edit source PDFs in place and only writes new output files.
